phrases.example: The ability to adapt is valuable in a changing workplace.
phrases.exampleZh: 适应能力在不断变化的职场中很有价值。

phrases.example: The project gives rural children better access to education.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个项目让农村儿童有更多受教育的机会。

phrases.example: We must take travel time into account when planning the meeting.
phrases.exampleZh: 安排会议时，我们必须考虑路上的时间。

phrases.example: She made a weekly plan to achieve her goal.
phrases.exampleZh: 她制订了每周计划来实现目标。

phrases.example: Students can take advantage of the library's free workshops.
phrases.exampleZh: 学生可以利用图书馆提供的免费讲习班。

phrases.example: Small changes in temperature can affect the outcome.
phrases.exampleZh: 温度的微小变化可能影响结果。

phrases.example: Cycling is a healthy alternative to driving.
phrases.exampleZh: 骑自行车是一种可以代替开车的健康出行方式。

phrases.example: The report provides a detailed analysis of energy use.
phrases.exampleZh: 报告对能源使用情况进行了详细分析。

phrases.example: We need a practical approach to reducing waste.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们需要一种切实可行的减少浪费的方法。

phrases.example: Researchers will assess the impact of the new policy.
phrases.exampleZh: 研究人员将评估新政策的影响。

phrases.example: A new manager will assume responsibility for the project.
phrases.exampleZh: 一位新经理将承担这个项目的管理责任。

phrases.example: Reliable information is not always readily available.
phrases.exampleZh: 可靠的信息并非总是容易获得。

phrases.example: Small businesses can benefit from better public transport.
phrases.exampleZh: 小企业可以从改善的公共交通中受益。

phrases.example: The team developed new skills to meet the challenge.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队掌握了新技能来应对这一挑战。

phrases.example: Compare your results with those from the previous experiment.
phrases.exampleZh: 把你的结果与上一次实验的结果进行比较。

phrases.example: The proposed road has raised concerns about noise.
phrases.exampleZh: 拟建的道路引发了人们对噪声的担忧。

phrases.example: We need more evidence before we can draw a conclusion.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们需要更多证据才能得出结论。

phrases.example: The university conducts research on renewable energy.
phrases.exampleZh: 这所大学开展可再生能源研究。

phrases.example: We should consider the possibility of working together.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们应该考虑合作的可能性。

phrases.example: Regular exercise can contribute to better sleep.
phrases.exampleZh: 经常运动有助于改善睡眠。

phrases.example: The service provides fresh meals at a reasonable cost.
phrases.exampleZh: 这项服务以合理的价格供应新鲜餐食。

phrases.example: The training programme creates opportunities for young people.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个培训项目为年轻人创造机会。

phrases.example: The course encourages critical thinking through open discussion.
phrases.exampleZh: 这门课程通过开放讨论培养批判性思维。

phrases.example: The factory hired more workers to meet demand.
phrases.exampleZh: 工厂雇用了更多工人来满足需求。

phrases.example: The final schedule will depend on the weather.
phrases.exampleZh: 最终日程将取决于天气。

phrases.example: A small donation can make a difference to a local charity.
phrases.exampleZh: 一笔小额捐款也能为当地慈善机构带来帮助。

phrases.example: Tourism supports many jobs in the local economy.
phrases.exampleZh: 旅游业为当地经济提供了许多就业岗位。

phrases.example: Sleep can have an effect on memory.
phrases.exampleZh: 睡眠会影响记忆。

phrases.example: The new heating system is more energy efficient.
phrases.exampleZh: 新的供暖系统更加节能。

phrases.example: The school places emphasis on independent learning.
phrases.exampleZh: 学校重视自主学习。

phrases.example: The plan aims to protect the natural environment.
phrases.exampleZh: 该计划旨在保护自然环境。

phrases.example: Clean water is essential for good health.
phrases.exampleZh: 清洁的水对健康必不可少。

phrases.example: The survey provides evidence of changing shopping habits.
phrases.exampleZh: 这项调查提供了购物习惯发生变化的证据。

phrases.example: The programme will expand access to online courses.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个项目将让更多人有机会参加网络课程。

phrases.example: She volunteered at the museum to gain experience.
phrases.exampleZh: 她在博物馆做志愿者以积累经验。

phrases.example: Location is a key factor when choosing a shop.
phrases.exampleZh: 选择店铺时，位置是一个关键因素。

phrases.example: This chapter focuses on the causes of urban growth.
phrases.exampleZh: 本章重点讨论城市发展的原因。

phrases.example: Each part of the machine performs a different function.
phrases.exampleZh: 机器的每个部件都发挥不同的作用。

phrases.example: The new railway will have an impact on local businesses.
phrases.exampleZh: 新铁路将对当地企业产生影响。

phrases.example: The team simplified the process to improve efficiency.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队简化了流程以提高效率。

phrases.example: The city recorded an increase in bicycle use.
phrases.exampleZh: 这座城市的自行车使用量有所增加。

phrases.example: These figures indicate a trend towards smaller households.
phrases.exampleZh: 这些数据表明家庭规模趋于缩小。

phrases.example: Good teaching takes individual needs into account.
phrases.exampleZh: 良好的教学会考虑个人需求。

phrases.example: Large companies can exert influence on public debate.
phrases.exampleZh: 大公司可以对公共讨论施加影响。

phrases.example: The committee met to address the issue of overcrowding.
phrases.exampleZh: 委员会开会处理过度拥挤的问题。

phrases.example: Students acquire knowledge through reading and practice.
phrases.exampleZh: 学生通过阅读和实践获取知识。

phrases.example: We should set a limit on how much we spend.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们应该设定支出的上限。

phrases.example: It can be difficult to maintain a balance between work and study.
phrases.exampleZh: 兼顾工作和学习可能很困难。

phrases.example: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge.
phrases.exampleZh: 提供价格可负担的住房仍是一项重大挑战。

phrases.example: The city has taken measures to reduce traffic noise.
phrases.exampleZh: 该市已采取措施减少交通噪声。

phrases.example: We need a reliable method for measuring air quality.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们需要一种可靠的空气质量测量方法。

phrases.example: The exchange gave us an opportunity to learn about another culture.
phrases.exampleZh: 这次交流让我们有机会了解另一种文化。

phrases.example: More than a hundred students participated in the survey.
phrases.exampleZh: 一百多名学生参加了调查。

phrases.example: The council plans to implement a new recycling policy.
phrases.exampleZh: 地方议会计划实施一项新的回收政策。

phrases.example: Supportive teachers help students realise their potential.
phrases.exampleZh: 善于鼓励的老师帮助学生发挥潜力。

phrases.example: A protective case can help prevent damage to the device.
phrases.exampleZh: 保护套有助于防止设备损坏。

phrases.example: Equal treatment is a basic principle of the programme.
phrases.exampleZh: 平等对待是这个项目的一项基本原则。

phrases.example: Learning to write clearly is a gradual process.
phrases.exampleZh: 学会清晰地写作是一个渐进的过程。

phrases.example: The team has made progress in reducing production waste.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队在减少生产废料方面取得了进展。

phrases.example: The centre provides support for new business owners.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个中心为新创业者提供支持。

phrases.example: The data were collected for the purpose of improving the service.
phrases.exampleZh: 收集这些数据是为了改善服务。

phrases.example: The library offers a wide range of language courses.
phrases.exampleZh: 图书馆提供多种语言课程。

phrases.example: Regular maintenance can reduce the risk of equipment failure.
phrases.exampleZh: 定期维护可以降低设备发生故障的风险。

phrases.example: Take a few minutes to reflect on what you have learned.
phrases.exampleZh: 花几分钟认真回顾一下你学到的内容。

phrases.example: Several details in the plan still require attention.
phrases.exampleZh: 计划中仍有几个细节需要关注。

phrases.example: The team presented its research findings at the conference.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队在会议上展示了研究结果。

phrases.example: The region is rich in natural resources.
phrases.exampleZh: 这一地区自然资源丰富。

phrases.example: The company responded to customer feedback by changing the design.
phrases.exampleZh: 公司根据客户反馈修改了设计。

phrases.example: Several trains were delayed as a result of heavy rain.
phrases.exampleZh: 由于大雨，几趟列车晚点了。

phrases.example: Libraries play an important role in community life.
phrases.exampleZh: 图书馆在社区生活中发挥重要作用。

phrases.example: There is a significant difference in price between the two models.
phrases.exampleZh: 这两种型号的价格有明显差异。

phrases.example: Check whether the information comes from a reliable source.
phrases.exampleZh: 核查这些信息是否来自可靠的来源。

phrases.example: The team developed a strategy to attract new readers.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队制定了吸引新读者的策略。

phrases.example: Several residents spoke in support of the proposal.
phrases.exampleZh: 几位居民发言支持这项提议。

phrases.example: Remote work is a growing trend in the technology sector.
phrases.exampleZh: 远程办公在科技行业中日益普遍。

phrases.example: The basic model offers good value for money.
phrases.exampleZh: 基础款很实惠。

phrases.example: The market sells a variety of fresh vegetables.
phrases.exampleZh: 市场出售各种新鲜蔬菜。

phrases.example: Small companies can achieve success by meeting needs that larger firms overlook.
phrases.exampleZh: 小公司可以通过满足大公司忽视的需求来取得成功。

phrases.example: The course aims to achieve a balance between theory and practice.
phrases.exampleZh: 这门课程旨在实现理论与实践之间的平衡。

phrases.example: The workshop introduces basic data analysis using a small survey.
phrases.exampleZh: 这次工作坊通过一项小型调查介绍基本的数据分析方法。

phrases.example: Her comparative analysis explains why the two cities adopted different transport policies.
phrases.exampleZh: 她的比较分析解释了这两座城市为何采取不同的交通政策。

phrases.example: We applied the same method to all three sets of measurements.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们对三组测量数据都采用了同一种方法。

phrases.example: The museum will apply for funding to restore the old photographs.
phrases.exampleZh: 博物馆将申请资助，以修复这些老照片。

phrases.example: Several speakers argued for reform by describing problems with the current system.
phrases.exampleZh: 几位发言者通过描述现行制度的问题，阐述了支持改革的理由。

phrases.meaning: 提出理由反对一项提议
phrases.example: The residents argued against the proposal because it would remove their only park.
phrases.exampleZh: 居民们反对这项提议，因为它会让他们失去唯一的公园。

phrases.word: associate a smell with a memory
phrases.meaning: 把一种气味与一段记忆联系起来
phrases.example: I associate the smell of fresh bread with visits to my grandparents.
phrases.exampleZh: 新鲜面包的气味总让我想起去看望祖父母的时光。

phrases.example: In this survey, regular library visits were associated with greater enjoyment of reading.
phrases.exampleZh: 在这项调查中，定期去图书馆与更高的阅读兴趣有关。

phrases.example: The first model attempted to solve the problem by changing the delivery route.
phrases.exampleZh: 第一个模型尝试通过改变配送路线来解决问题。

phrases.example: He made another attempt to contact the editor after checking the address.
phrases.exampleZh: 核对地址后，他再次尝试联系编辑。

phrases.example: Calculate the average of the five readings and record it below.
phrases.exampleZh: 计算这五次读数的平均值，并把结果记在下面。

phrases.example: The organizer calculated the cost of hiring an extra room.
phrases.exampleZh: 组织者计算了额外租用一个房间的费用。

phrases.example: The author claims that the policy saved money but provides no figures.
phrases.exampleZh: 作者声称这项政策节省了开支，却没有提供数据。

phrases.example: Two independent surveys support the claim that passengers want later bus services.
phrases.exampleZh: 两项独立调查支持了乘客希望公交运营到更晚的这一说法。

phrases.example: We classified the expenses into three categories to make the budget easier to read.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们把支出分为三类，使预算更容易理解。

phrases.example: The library classifies this book as historical fiction.
phrases.exampleZh: 图书馆把这本书归类为历史小说。

phrases.example: The two groups compared their results after repeating the experiment.
phrases.exampleZh: 两组在重复实验后比较了各自的结果。

phrases.example: We compared prices at three shops before ordering the equipment.
phrases.exampleZh: 订购设备前，我们比较了三家商店的价格。

phrases.example: Parents expressed concern about safety near the school entrance.
phrases.exampleZh: 家长们表达了对校门口安全问题的担忧。

phrases.meaning: 日益加剧的担忧；越来越受关注的问题
phrases.example: The lack of affordable housing is a growing concern in the town.
phrases.exampleZh: 缺少可负担的住房正成为镇上越来越受关注的问题。

phrases.example: Each colour on the chart corresponds to a different age group.
phrases.exampleZh: 图表上的每一种颜色都对应一个不同的年龄组。

phrases.example: She corresponded with a colleague abroad while preparing the exhibition.
phrases.exampleZh: 筹备展览期间，她与一位在国外的同事保持通信。

phrases.example: The restoration has reached a critical stage, when the fragile roof must be secured.
phrases.exampleZh: 修复工作已进入关键阶段，需要加固脆弱的屋顶。

phrases.example: Clear communication is critical to the success of a rescue operation.
phrases.exampleZh: 清晰的沟通对救援行动的成功至关重要。

phrases.example: Daily visitor numbers fluctuated between fifty and eighty last week.
phrases.exampleZh: 上周，每天的访客人数在五十到八十之间波动。

phrases.example: Demand for outdoor seating can fluctuate widely with the weather.
phrases.exampleZh: 室外座位的需求可能随天气大幅波动。

phrases.example: The committee formulated a plan to keep the reading room open longer.
phrases.exampleZh: 委员会制订了延长阅览室开放时间的计划。

phrases.example: Before testing the materials, the team formulated a hypothesis about their strength.
phrases.exampleZh: 在测试材料之前，团队提出了一个关于材料强度的假设。

phrases.example: The final design differs from the version shown at the first meeting.
phrases.exampleZh: 最终设计与第一次会议上展示的版本不同。

phrases.example: The two rooms differ in size but receive the same amount of sunlight.
phrases.exampleZh: 这两个房间大小不同，但日照条件相同。

phrases.example: The study follows families for several years to examine the long-term effects of relocation.
phrases.exampleZh: 这项研究对多个家庭跟踪数年，以考察搬迁的长期影响。

phrases.example: The revised opening hours will take effect next Monday.
phrases.exampleZh: 调整后的开放时间将从下周一开始实行。

phrases.example: We can infer from the evidence that the building was repaired more than once.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们可以根据证据推断，这座建筑曾多次修缮。

phrases.example: From the empty shelves, she inferred that the sale had been successful.
phrases.exampleZh: 看到空空的货架，她推断这次促销很成功。

phrases.example: Engineers are investigating the cause of the repeated power failures.
phrases.exampleZh: 工程师们正在调查反复停电的原因。

phrases.example: The manager promised to investigate the complaint and check the delivery records.
phrases.exampleZh: 经理承诺调查这起投诉，并核查配送记录。

phrases.example: Each presentation has a time limit of eight minutes.
phrases.exampleZh: 每次展示的时间限制为八分钟。

phrases.example: The archive limits access to fragile documents to protect them from damage.
phrases.exampleZh: 档案馆限制查阅易损文献，以免它们受损。

phrases.example: The article explores the link between reading habits and access to libraries.
phrases.exampleZh: 这篇文章探讨了阅读习惯与图书馆使用机会之间的联系。

phrases.meaning: 把理论与实践联系起来
phrases.example: The placement helps students link theory to practice in a real workplace.
phrases.exampleZh: 实习帮助学生在真实的工作环境中把理论与实践联系起来。

phrases.example: A sensor measures the temperature inside the storage room every hour.
phrases.exampleZh: 传感器每小时测量一次储藏室内的温度。

phrases.example: Weekly reading checks help the teacher measure each student's progress.
phrases.exampleZh: 每周的阅读检查帮助老师衡量每个学生的进步。

phrases.example: The team monitors changes in air quality near the construction site.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队持续监测施工现场附近空气质量的变化。

phrases.example: The software monitors the performance of the cooling system throughout the day.
phrases.exampleZh: 这套软件全天监测冷却系统的运行情况。

phrases.example: Even an unsuccessful trial can have a positive outcome if it reveals a design flaw.
phrases.exampleZh: 即使试验没有成功，只要发现了设计缺陷，也能带来积极的结果。

phrases.example: We cannot judge the final outcome until all the responses have been counted.
phrases.exampleZh: 所有回复统计完毕之前，我们还不能判断最终结果。

phrases.example: The interviews revealed a pattern of behaviour that the short survey had missed.
phrases.exampleZh: 访谈揭示了一种简短问卷未能发现的行为模式。

phrases.example: Plotting the figures on a graph helped us identify a pattern.
phrases.exampleZh: 把数字绘成图表帮助我们识别出了规律。

phrases.example: A small change to the timetable has the potential to reduce waiting times.
phrases.exampleZh: 稍微调整时刻表就有可能缩短等候时间。

phrases.example: The report weighs the potential benefits of the scheme against its cost.
phrases.exampleZh: 报告权衡了这个方案的潜在益处和成本。

phrases.example: It is difficult to predict the outcome of the vote from such a small survey.
phrases.exampleZh: 仅凭这么小规模的调查，很难预测投票结果。

phrases.example: No single model can accurately predict every change in demand.
phrases.exampleZh: 没有任何单一模型能够准确预测需求的每一次变化。

phrases.example: The training uses real examples to show how careful checks can prevent accidents.
phrases.exampleZh: 培训通过真实案例说明，仔细检查如何能够预防事故。

phrases.example: The team changed the backup process to prevent the same error from happening again.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队更改了备份流程，以防止同样的错误再次发生。

phrases.example: The council will give priority to repairs on roads used by school buses.
phrases.exampleZh: 市政委员会将优先修缮校车通行的道路。

phrases.example: Keeping the original records safe is a top priority for the archive.
phrases.exampleZh: 确保原始记录安全是档案馆的首要任务。

phrases.example: Staff must follow the correct procedure when reporting missing equipment.
phrases.exampleZh: 员工报告设备遗失时必须遵循正确程序。

phrases.example: The laboratory has a standard procedure for labelling every sample.
phrases.exampleZh: 实验室有一套为每份样本贴标签的标准程序。

phrases.example: After listening to both sides, the mediator proposed a solution they could test.
phrases.exampleZh: 听取双方意见后，调解人提出了一个可供双方尝试的解决方案。

phrases.example: The editor proposed a change to the opening paragraph to make the purpose clearer.
phrases.exampleZh: 编辑建议修改开头一段，让文章目的更清晰。

phrases.example: He used the original records to prove a point about the building's age.
phrases.exampleZh: 他用原始记录证明了自己关于这座建筑年代的一个观点。

phrases.example: The sketches proved to be useful when the original plans could not be found.
phrases.exampleZh: 找不到原始方案时，这些草图派上了用场。

phrases.example: The latest figures reflect a change in how residents travel to work.
phrases.exampleZh: 最新数据反映了居民通勤方式的变化。

phrases.example: A survey of only one neighbourhood may not reflect public opinion across the city.
phrases.exampleZh: 只调查一个社区，未必能反映全市的公众意见。

phrases.example: The poster uses a simple image to reinforce its message about saving water.
phrases.exampleZh: 海报用一个简单的图像强化了节约用水的信息。

phrases.example: Explaining a concept to a partner can reinforce learning.
phrases.exampleZh: 向同伴解释一个概念，可以巩固所学内容。

phrases.example: Two students were elected to represent their group at the planning meeting.
phrases.exampleZh: 两名学生获选，在规划会议上代表他们的小组。

phrases.example: Online orders represent a larger proportion of sales than they did last year.
phrases.exampleZh: 与去年相比，线上订单在销售额中所占的比例更大。

phrases.example: An independent mediator helped the two organizations resolve their dispute.
phrases.exampleZh: 一位独立调解人帮助这两个机构解决了争端。

phrases.example: Replacing the cable resolved the problem with the classroom projector.
phrases.exampleZh: 更换电缆解决了教室投影仪的问题。

phrases.example: The laboratory restricts access while sensitive equipment is being tested.
phrases.exampleZh: 实验室测试精密设备时会限制人员进入。

phrases.example: The discount is restricted to tickets purchased before Friday.
phrases.exampleZh: 这项折扣仅适用于星期五之前购买的票。

phrases.example: Before reaching a conclusion, the panel reviewed all the available evidence.
phrases.exampleZh: 作出结论前，评审小组审查了所有现有证据。

phrases.example: Her literature review identifies questions that earlier studies have not answered.
phrases.exampleZh: 她的文献综述指出了以往研究尚未回答的问题。

phrases.example: We revised the draft to remove repeated ideas and explain the main claim.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们修改了草稿，删去重复观点，并阐明主要主张。

phrases.example: The team revised its estimate when the full list of repairs became available.
phrases.exampleZh: 完整的维修清单出炉后，团队修正了原先的估计。

phrases.example: A representative sample should include people from across the population being studied.
phrases.exampleZh: 有代表性的样本应包含所研究总体中不同部分的人群。

phrases.example: The students labelled each water sample with its collection time and location.
phrases.exampleZh: 学生们给每份水样标注了采集时间和地点。

phrases.example: A full history of the railway is beyond the scope of this article.
phrases.exampleZh: 完整介绍这条铁路的历史超出了本文的范围。

phrases.example: The service is reliable, but there is still scope for improvement in its booking system.
phrases.exampleZh: 这项服务很可靠，但预订系统仍有改进的空间。

phrases.example: New researchers can seek advice from the library's subject specialists.
phrases.exampleZh: 研究新手可以向图书馆的学科专家寻求建议。

phrases.example: You must seek permission before reproducing photographs from the collection.
phrases.exampleZh: 复制馆藏照片之前，必须征得许可。

phrases.example: The researchers selected twenty addresses at random from the register.
phrases.exampleZh: 研究人员从登记册中随机选出了二十个地址。

phrases.example: Five essays were selected for inclusion in the student magazine.
phrases.exampleZh: 五篇文章获选刊登在学生杂志上。

phrases.example: The invitation specifies a deadline for submitting questions to the speakers.
phrases.exampleZh: 邀请函明确规定了向演讲者提交问题的截止时间。

phrases.example: The course guide specifies the requirements for the final project.
phrases.exampleZh: 课程指南明确规定了期末项目的要求。

phrases.example: The city needs a long-term strategy for maintaining its older buildings.
phrases.exampleZh: 这座城市需要一项维护老建筑的长期策略。

phrases.example: Grouping related ideas can be an effective strategy for planning an essay.
phrases.exampleZh: 把相关观点归为一组，可以成为构思文章的有效策略。

phrases.example: Each group must submit a proposal explaining the purpose of its project.
phrases.exampleZh: 每个小组都必须提交一份说明项目目的的提案。

phrases.example: The author submitted the revised manuscript for review last week.
phrases.exampleZh: 作者上周提交了修订后的稿件供审核。

phrases.example: The speaker summarized the findings before discussing their limitations.
phrases.exampleZh: 发言者先概括了研究发现，再讨论其局限性。

phrases.example: Try to summarize the main points of the article in three sentences.
phrases.exampleZh: 试着用三句话概括这篇文章的要点。

phrases.example: The teacher uses changing examples to sustain students' interest in the topic.
phrases.exampleZh: 老师不断更换例子，以保持学生对这个话题的兴趣。

phrases.example: The company will need more trained staff to sustain its recent growth.
phrases.exampleZh: 公司需要更多受过培训的员工，才能保持近期的增长。

phrases.example: The chart shows an upward trend in library membership over five years.
phrases.exampleZh: 图表显示，五年来图书馆会员人数呈上升趋势。

phrases.example: The new evening classes helped reverse the trend of falling enrolment.
phrases.exampleZh: 新开的晚间课程帮助扭转了报名人数下降的趋势。

phrases.example: We checked the receipts to verify the accuracy of the expense report.
phrases.exampleZh: 我们核对了收据，以确认费用报告的准确性。

phrases.example: Journalists should verify information before including it in a report.
phrases.exampleZh: 记者应先核实信息，再将其写入报道。

phrases.example: We made an assumption about travel time because the route had not been tested.
phrases.exampleZh: 由于路线尚未测试，我们对通行时间作了一个假设。

phrases.example: The unexpected result led the researchers to challenge their original assumption.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个意外结果促使研究人员质疑最初的假设。

phrases.example: The report makes a comparison between the costs of repairing and replacing the roof.
phrases.exampleZh: 报告比较了修缮和更换屋顶的费用。

phrases.example: This year's event was smaller in comparison with last year's festival.
phrases.exampleZh: 与去年的节庆活动相比，今年活动的规模更小。

phrases.example: We agreed on a working definition of success before evaluating the project.
phrases.exampleZh: 评估项目前，我们就“成功”暂定了一个共同定义。

phrases.example: A square, by definition, has four equal sides and four right angles.
phrases.exampleZh: 按照定义，正方形有四条等长的边和四个直角。

phrases.example: The revised course puts emphasis on using evidence to support an argument.
phrases.exampleZh: 修订后的课程强调用证据支持论点。

phrases.example: The museum has shifted the emphasis from famous leaders to everyday life.
phrases.exampleZh: 博物馆已把展示重点从著名领袖转向日常生活。

phrases.example: The passage carries the implication that the narrator does not trust the visitor.
phrases.exampleZh: 这个段落暗示叙述者并不信任来访者。

phrases.example: The speaker praised the new design and, by implication, criticized the old one.
phrases.exampleZh: 发言者赞扬了新设计，也含蓄地批评了旧设计。

phrases.example: Observing the workshop helped us gain insight into how the group makes decisions.
phrases.exampleZh: 观察这场工作坊帮助我们深入了解了小组如何作出决定。

phrases.example: Her diary provides an insight into daily life in the town a century ago.
phrases.exampleZh: 她的日记使人得以深入了解一个世纪前这座小镇的日常生活。

phrases.example: The team assessed the reliability of the old records before using them as evidence.
phrases.exampleZh: 团队在把旧记录用作证据之前，先评估了其可靠性。

phrases.example: Regular maintenance improved the reliability of the heating system.
phrases.exampleZh: 定期维护提高了供暖系统的可靠性。

phrases.example: The organizer added a second session in response to strong demand.
phrases.exampleZh: 由于需求旺盛，组织者增加了一场活动。

phrases.example: A prompt response helped the visitor correct the booking before the deadline.
phrases.exampleZh: 迅速的回应帮助这位访客在截止时间前更正了预订。

phrases.example: In this test, the amount of light is the independent variable set by the researchers.
phrases.exampleZh: 在这项测试中，光照量是研究人员设定的自变量。

phrases.example: Plant height is the dependent variable measured at the end of each week.
phrases.exampleZh: 植物高度是每周末测量的因变量。

phrases.example: Several missing records led us to question the validity of the comparison.
phrases.exampleZh: 几份记录的缺失使我们质疑这次比较是否有效。

phrases.example: More evidence is needed to establish the validity of the proposed explanation.
phrases.exampleZh: 还需要更多证据来确认所提出的解释是否成立。
